---
title: "DK1 day ahead electricity price"
format:
  dashboard:
    theme: [cosmo, theme.scss]
    embed-resources: true
    nav-buttons:
      - icon: github
        href: https://github.com/jacobazu/dk1-price-forecasting
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
        <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
execute:
  echo: false

```{r}
#| include: false
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(lubridate)
library(plotly)

Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "C")   # English day and month names, also on a Danish computer

orange <- "#f97316"
grey   <- "#6b7280"
ink    <- "#1f2328"

# actual prices in DK time
actual <- readRDS("data/processed/prices_dk1_hourly.rds") |>
  mutate(local = with_tz(time, "Europe/Copenhagen"),
         date  = as_date(local),
         hour  = hour(local)) |>
  group_by(date, hour) |>
  summarise(actual = mean(price), .groups = "drop")

# live forecasts
fc <- read_csv("forecasts/forecasts_live.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(date = as_date(date))

latest    <- max(fc$date)
tomorrow  <- fc |> filter(date == latest)
today_act <- actual |> filter(date == latest - 1)

# scored live forecasts (last 30 days)
scored <- fc |>
  inner_join(actual, by = c("date", "hour")) |>
  filter(date >= max(date) - 29)

eur  <- function(x) format(round(x, 1), nsmall = 1)

hour_label <- function(h) sprintf("%02d:00", h)
has_scores <- nrow(scored) > 0
mae <- function(col) {
  if (!has_scores || !col %in% names(scored)) return("\u2013")
  s <- scored[!is.na(scored[[col]]), ]
  if (nrow(s) == 0) "\u2013" else eur(mean(abs(s$actual - s[[col]])))
}

# Models: a button appears automatically for every model column in forecasts_live.csv.
# To add a model later, add its column name, label and colour here.
model_labels <- c(lear      = "LEAR",
                  bmt       = "BMT",
                  bmtx      = "BMT-X",
                  learx     = "LEAR-X",
                  xgb       = "XGBoost",
                  ensemble  = "Ensemble",
                  naive_day = "Naive")
model_colors <- c(lear      = "#f97316",
                  bmt       = "#2563eb",
                  bmtx      = "#7c3aed",
                  learx     = "#0ea5e9",
                  xgb       = "#16a34a",
                  ensemble  = "#8b5cf6",
                  naive_day = "#9ca3af")
models <- intersect(names(model_labels), names(fc))

# buttons above a chart: one per model plus "All", actual prices are always shown
# html buttons instead of plotly's own, so they can be styled in theme.scss
model_buttons <- function(p, models) {
  vis <- c(lapply(models, \(m) c(TRUE, models == m)), list(rep(TRUE, length(models) + 1)))
  htmlwidgets::onRender(p, "
    function(el, x, data) {
      el.style.position = 'relative';
      var bar = document.createElement('div');
      bar.className = 'model-buttons';
      data.labels.forEach(function(lab, i) {
        var b = document.createElement('button');
        b.textContent = lab;
        if (i === 0) b.className = 'active';
        b.onclick = function() {
          Plotly.restyle(el, {visible: data.visible[i]});
          bar.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(o) { o.className = ''; });
          b.className = 'active';
        };
        bar.appendChild(b);
      });
      el.appendChild(bar);
    }",
    data = list(labels = c(unname(model_labels[models]), "All"), visible = vis))
}

chart_layout <- function(p, models = NULL, xtitle = "") {
  p <- p |>
    layout(paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
           plot_bgcolor  = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
           font = list(family = "Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif", color = grey),
           xaxis = list(title = xtitle, showgrid = FALSE, zeroline = FALSE, color = grey,
                        linecolor = "#e5ddd3"),
           yaxis = list(title = "", color = grey, gridcolor = "#f1ebe4",
                        zerolinecolor = "#cfc6bb"),
           legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = -0.15, font = list(color = ink)),
           hovermode = "x unified",
           hoverlabel = list(bgcolor = "#ffffff", bordercolor = "#efe6dc",
                             font = list(color = ink)),
           margin = list(t = 50)) |>
    config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
  if (length(models) > 0) p <- model_buttons(p, models)
  p
}

# results from the backtest scripts (results/*.csv), nothing on the dashboard is typed in by hand
read_res <- function(f) if (file.exists(f)) read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE) else NULL
eval_acc   <- read_res("results/eval_accuracy.csv")    # 09_evaluate.R
eval_tests <- read_res("results/eval_tests.csv")
eval_bias  <- read_res("results/eval_bias.csv")
eval_shape <- read_res("results/eval_shape.csv")
bmt_sel    <- read_res("results/bmt_selection.csv")    # 06_bmt.R
bmtx_combo <- read_res("results/bmtx_combos.csv")      # 09_evaluate.R
bmtx_sel   <- read_res("results/bmtx_selection.csv")   # 08_bmtx.R
bat_daily  <- read_res("results/battery_daily.csv")    # 10_battery.R
bat_sum    <- read_res("results/battery_summary.csv")
bat_tests  <- read_res("results/battery_tests.csv")
bat_setup  <- read_res("results/battery_setup.csv")
has_eval    <- !is.null(eval_acc)
has_battery <- !is.null(bat_sum)

long_labels <- c(perfect = "Perfect foresight", bmt = "BMT", lear = "LEAR",
                 bmtx = "BMT-X (all groups)", learx = "LEAR-X (all groups)",
                 naive_day = "Naive: same hour yesterday", naive_mix = "Naive: weekly mix")
text_labels <- c(perfect = "perfect foresight", bmt = "BMT", lear = "LEAR",
                 bmtx = "BMT-X", learx = "LEAR-X",
                 naive_day = "same hour yesterday", naive_mix = "the weekly mix")
strat_colors <- c(perfect = "#9ca3af", bmt = "#2563eb", lear = orange,
                  naive_mix = "#0ea5e9", naive_day = grey)

pct      <- function(x) paste0(format(round(100 * x, 1), nsmall = 1), "%")
eur_sign <- function(x) paste0(if (x >= 0) "+" else "\u2212", prettyNum(abs(round(x)), big.mark = ","))
p_txt    <- function(p) if (p < 0.001) "p < 0.001" else paste("p =", format(round(p, 3), nsmall = 3))
p_tab    <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.001, "<0.001", format(round(p, 3), nsmall = 3))

# main model: lowest backtest mae among the real models that have a forecast for tomorrow
real_models <- setdiff(models, "naive_day")
avail <- real_models[sapply(real_models, \(m) !all(is.na(tomorrow[[m]])))]
main  <- if (has_eval) {
  ranked <- eval_acc$model[eval_acc$model %in% avail]
  if (length(ranked) > 0) ranked[1] else avail[1]
} else avail[1]
main_label <- model_labels[[main]]

# backtest tile: best model vs naive same hour yesterday
best_bt    <- if (has_eval && main %in% eval_acc$model) main else NA
bt_improve <- if (!is.na(best_bt)) paste0("\u2212", round(100 * (1 - eval_acc$rmae[eval_acc$model == best_bt])), "%") else "\u2013"
bt_label   <- if (!is.na(best_bt)) text_labels[[best_bt]] else ""

# tests: find a row for two models in either order
find_test <- function(tab, a, b) {
  r <- tab[(tab$model_a == a & tab$model_b == b) | (tab$model_a == b & tab$model_b == a), ]
  if (nrow(r) == 0) return(NULL)
  if (r$model_a != a) {   # flip so the numbers are for a vs b
    for (col in intersect(c("mae_diff", "mean_eur_per_day", "dm_stat", "dm_sq_stat", "t"), names(r))) r[[col]] <- -r[[col]]
    if ("hours_a_better" %in% names(r)) r[c("hours_a_better", "hours_b_better")] <- r[c("hours_b_better", "hours_a_better")]
  }
  r
}

# accuracy text
acc_txt <- if (has_eval) {
  naive_best <- eval_acc$model[grepl("^naive", eval_acc$model)][1]
  real <- eval_acc |> filter(!grepl("^naive", model))
  imp  <- round(100 * (1 - real$mae / eval_acc$mae[eval_acc$model == naive_best]))
  paste0(paste(sprintf("%s cuts the average error by %d%%", long_labels[real$model], imp), collapse = ", "),
         " compared with the best naive benchmark (", long_labels[[naive_best]], ").")
} else ""

sig_txt <- if (has_eval && nrow(filter(eval_acc, !grepl("^naive", model))) >= 2) {
  top <- eval_acc$model[!grepl("^naive", eval_acc$model)][1:2]
  r   <- find_test(eval_tests, top[1], top[2])
  if (r$dm_p < 0.05 && r$gw_p < 0.05) {
    sprintf("%s is significantly more accurate than %s (DM %s, GW %s), better in %d and worse in %d of the 24 hours.",
            long_labels[[top[1]]], long_labels[[top[2]]], p_txt(r$dm_p), p_txt(r$gw_p),
            r$hours_a_better, r$hours_b_better)
  } else {
    sprintf("%s has the lower MAE, but the difference to %s is not clearly significant (DM %s, GW %s).",
            long_labels[[top[1]]], long_labels[[top[2]]], p_txt(r$dm_p), p_txt(r$gw_p))
  }
} else ""

bmt_avg_sel <- if (!is.null(bmt_sel)) format(round(sum(bmt_sel$share) / n_distinct(bmt_sel$target), 1), nsmall = 1) else "\u2013"
bmt_n_cand  <- if (!is.null(bmt_sel)) n_distinct(bmt_sel$input) else "\u2013"
eval_period <- if (has_eval) sprintf("%s to %s, %d days, %s hourly forecasts",
                                     format(eval_acc$from[1], "%d %b %Y"), format(eval_acc$to[1], "%d %b %Y"),
                                     eval_acc$n_days[1], prettyNum(eval_acc$n_hours[1], big.mark = ",")) else ""

# BMT-X combinations (variables tab)
has_bmtx  <- !is.null(bmtx_combo)
group_txt <- c(nb = "neighbour prices", wind = "wind", solar = "solar", hol = "holidays")
combo_txt <- function(combo) {
  if (combo == "prices") return("DK1 prices only")
  paste("DK1 prices +", paste(group_txt[strsplit(combo, "+", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]], collapse = " + "))
}
bmtx_txt <- if (has_bmtx) {
  best  <- bmtx_combo[1, ]
  base  <- bmtx_combo[bmtx_combo$combo == "prices", ]
  n_in  <- sum(bmtx_combo$in_mcs)
  lx    <- eval_acc[eval_acc$model == "learx", ]
  bx    <- eval_acc[eval_acc$model == "bmtx", ]
  t_x   <- if (has_eval) find_test(eval_tests, "bmtx", "learx") else NULL
  paste0(
    "The best combination is ", combo_txt(best$combo), " with MAE ", format(round(best$mae, 1), nsmall = 1),
    sprintf(" (%s%.1f vs DK1 prices only). ", if (best$mae <= base$mae) "\u2212" else "+", abs(best$mae - base$mae)),
    n_in, " of the ", nrow(bmtx_combo), " combinations are in the 10% model confidence set, ",
    "so they can't be told apart from the best one. ",
    if (nrow(lx) == 1 && nrow(bx) == 1 && !is.null(t_x)) {
      sprintf("With all four groups, BMT-X has MAE %.1f and LEAR-X (lasso on the same variables) %.1f; %s.",
              bx$mae, lx$mae,
              if (t_x$dm_p < 0.05) sprintf("the difference is significant (DM %s)", p_txt(t_x$dm_p))
              else sprintf("the difference is not significant (DM %s)", p_txt(t_x$dm_p)))
    } else "")
} else ""

# battery
bat_val <- function(strategy, col) bat_sum[[col]][bat_sum$strategy == strategy]
bat_set <- function(name) bat_setup$value[bat_setup$name == name]
bat_best <- if (has_battery) bat_sum$strategy[!bat_sum$strategy %in% c("perfect", "naive_day", "naive_mix")][1] else NA
bat_best_label <- if (has_battery) long_labels[[bat_best]] else ""
bat_share <- if (has_battery) pct(bat_val(bat_best, "share_of_perfect")) else "\u2013"
bat_extra <- if (has_battery) eur_sign(bat_val(bat_best, "eur_per_mw_year") - bat_val("naive_day", "eur_per_mw_year")) else "\u2013"
bat_p     <- if (has_battery) p_txt(find_test(bat_tests, bat_best, "naive_day")$p_value) else "\u2013"
bat_days  <- if (has_battery) nrow(bat_daily) else 0

# battery text that follows the results
bat_cmp <- function(a, b) {
  r <- find_test(bat_tests, a, b)
  if (is.null(r)) return("")
  if (r$p_value < 0.05) {
    sprintf("%s earns significantly %s than %s (%s).", text_labels[[a]],
            if (r$mean_eur_per_day > 0) "more" else "less", text_labels[[b]], p_txt(r$p_value))
  } else {
    sprintf("%s and %s are not significantly different in profit (%s).",
            text_labels[[a]], text_labels[[b]], p_txt(r$p_value))
  }
}
# money vs accuracy for two forecasts
bat_rank <- function(a, b) {
  more_acc   <- bat_val(a, "mae") < bat_val(b, "mae")
  more_money <- bat_val(a, "total_eur") > bat_val(b, "total_eur")
  la <- text_labels[[a]]; lb <- text_labels[[b]]
  if (more_acc == more_money) {
    w <- if (more_acc) la else lb
    sprintf("%s is both more accurate and earns more.", w)
  } else {
    acc <- if (more_acc) la else lb
    mon <- if (more_money) la else lb
    sprintf("%s has the lower MAE, but %s earns more, since a battery only needs the shape of the day, not the level.", acc, mon)
  }
}
bat_txt <- if (has_battery) {
  real <- bat_sum$strategy[bat_sum$strategy %in% c("bmt", "lear")]
  parts <- c(bat_cmp(bat_best, "naive_day"), bat_cmp(bat_best, "naive_mix"))
  if (length(real) == 2) parts <- c(parts, bat_cmp(real[1], real[2]), bat_rank(real[1], real[2]))
  parts <- c(parts, paste("Of the two naive forecasts,", bat_rank("naive_mix", "naive_day")))
  parts <- parts[parts != ""]
  paste(paste0(toupper(substring(parts, 1, 1)), substring(parts, 2)), collapse = " ")
} else ""

# forecast tiles, from the main model
diff_today <- mean(tomorrow[[main]]) - mean(today_act$actual)
diff_html  <- if (is.na(diff_today)) "" else
  sprintf('<span class="%s">%s%s</span> vs today',
          if (diff_today > 0) "kpi-up" else "kpi-down",
          if (diff_today > 0) "+" else "\u2212", eur(abs(diff_today)))
cheap <- tomorrow[which.min(tomorrow[[main]]), ]
peak  <- tomorrow[which.max(tomorrow[[main]]), ]

bat_desc <- if (has_battery) sprintf("%g MWh / %g MW battery, %g%% round trip efficiency, max %g full cycle per day",
                                     bat_set("cap_mwh"), bat_set("power_mw"),
                                     100 * bat_set("eff_rt"), bat_set("max_cycle")) else ""
```

```{r}
#| title: "Tomorrow's forecast vs today's prices (EUR/MWh)"
p <- plot_ly() |>
  add_lines(data = today_act, x = ~hour, y = ~actual,
            name = paste("Actual,", format(latest - 1, "%a %d %b")),
            line = list(color = grey, width = 2, dash = "dot"),
            hovertemplate = "%{y:.1f} €/MWh<extra>Actual</extra>")

# Naive is left out here: its forecast for tomorrow is simply today's prices (the dotted line)
fc_models <- setdiff(models, "naive_day")
fc_models <- c(main, setdiff(fc_models, main))   # chart opens on the same model as the tiles

for (m in fc_models) {
  p <- p |>
    add_lines(data = tomorrow, x = ~hour, y = tomorrow[[m]],
              name = paste0(model_labels[[m]], ", ", format(latest, "%a %d %b")),
              visible = (m == fc_models[1]),
              line = list(color = model_colors[[m]], width = 3),
              hovertemplate = paste0("%{y:.1f} €/MWh<extra>", model_labels[[m]], "</extra>"))
}

p |> chart_layout(fc_models, xtitle = "Hour (Danish time)") |> layout(xaxis = list(dtick = 3))
```

```{r}
#| title: "Live forecasts vs actual prices, last 30 days (EUR/MWh)"
if (nrow(scored) == 0) {
  cat("The track record starts once the first forecast day has passed.")
} else {
  sc <- scored |> mutate(time = as_datetime(date, tz = "Europe/Copenhagen") + hours(hour))

  p2 <- plot_ly(sc, x = ~time) |>
    add_lines(y = ~actual, name = "Actual",
              line = list(color = ink, width = 1.5),
              hovertemplate = "%{y:.1f} €/MWh<extra>Actual</extra>")

  for (m in models) {
    p2 <- p2 |>
      add_lines(y = sc[[m]], name = model_labels[[m]],
                visible = (m == models[1]),
                line = list(color = model_colors[[m]], width = 1.5),
                hovertemplate = paste0("%{y:.1f} €/MWh<extra>", model_labels[[m]], "</extra>"))
  }

  p2 |> chart_layout(models)
}
```

```{r}
#| title: "Accuracy by model, last 30 days"
if (nrow(scored) > 0) {
  lapply(models, \(m) {
    s <- scored[!is.na(scored[[m]]), ]
    tibble(Model            = model_labels[[m]],
           `Days tracked`   = n_distinct(s$date),
           `MAE (€/MWh)`    = mean(abs(s$actual - s[[m]])),
           `RMSE (€/MWh)`   = sqrt(mean((s$actual - s[[m]])^2)))
  }) |>
    bind_rows() |>
    arrange(`MAE (€/MWh)`) |>

}
```

# Variables

## Row {height=100%}

::: {.card title="Which variables help? Tick the groups to add"}

DK1 prices from D-1, D-2, D-3 and D-7 are always candidates. Each ticked group adds candidates,
and BMT picks from all of them. Results are from the backtest; every combination is precomputed.

```{r}
if (has_bmtx) {
  dat <- bmtx_combo |>
    left_join(bmtx_sel, by = "combo") |>
    mutate(rank = row_number(), label = sapply(combo, combo_txt)) |>
    select(combo, label, rank, mae, rmse, rmae, mcs_p, in_mcs,
           n_sel, n_prices, n_nb, n_wind, n_solar, n_hol)
  base_mae <- dat$mae[dat$combo == "prices"]
  htmltools::HTML(paste0('
<div class="group-picker">
  <label><input type="checkbox" value="nb"> Neighbour prices <small>DE, DK2, NO2, SE3, SE4, yesterday</small></label>
  <label><input type="checkbox" value="wind"> Wind <small>offshore and onshore forecast for tomorrow</small></label>
  <label><input type="checkbox" value="solar"> Solar <small>forecast for tomorrow</small></label>
  <label><input type="checkbox" value="hol"> Holidays <small>tomorrow and today</small></label>
</div>
<div id="combo-result" class="combo-result"></div>
<script>
(function() {
  var data = ', jsonlite::toJSON(dat, dataframe = "rows", digits = 4), ';
  var base = ', base_mae, ';
  var n = data.length;
  var order = ["nb", "wind", "solar", "hol"];
  function key() {
    var on = order.filter(function(g) {
      return document.querySelector(".group-picker input[value=" + g + "]").checked;
    });
    return on.length ? on.join("+") : "prices";
  }
  function f(x, d) { return Number(x).toFixed(d); }
  function render() {
    var r = data.find(function(x) { return x.combo === key(); });
    var diff = r.mae - base;
    var mcs = r.in_mcs
      ? "<span class=\'tag good\'>in the model confidence set</span> (p = " + f(r.mcs_p, 2) + ")"
      : "<span class=\'tag\'>not in the model confidence set</span> (p = " + f(r.mcs_p, 3) + ")";
    document.getElementById("combo-result").innerHTML =
      "<div class=\'combo-name\'>" + r.label + "</div>" +
      "<div class=\'combo-stats\'>" +
      "<div><span>MAE</span><b>" + f(r.mae, 1) + "</b><small>" +
        (r.combo === "prices" ? "baseline" : (diff <= 0 ? "\u2212" : "+") + f(Math.abs(diff), 1) + " vs prices only") + "</small></div>" +
      "<div><span>RMSE</span><b>" + f(r.rmse, 1) + "</b><small>\u20ac/MWh</small></div>" +
      "<div><span>Rank</span><b>" + r.rank + " / " + n + "</b><small>by MAE</small></div>" +
      "</div>" +
      "<p>" + mcs + "</p>" +
      "<p>BMT picks on average " + f(r.n_sel, 1) + " variables per hour: " +
      f(r.n_prices, 1) + " DK1 prices" +
      (r.n_nb > 0 || key().indexOf("nb") >= 0 ? ", " + f(r.n_nb, 1) + " neighbour prices" : "") +
      (r.n_wind > 0 || key().indexOf("wind") >= 0 ? ", " + f(r.n_wind, 1) + " wind" : "") +
      (r.n_solar > 0 || key().indexOf("solar") >= 0 ? ", " + f(r.n_solar, 1) + " solar" : "") +
      (r.n_hol > 0 || key().indexOf("hol") >= 0 ? ", " + f(r.n_hol, 1) + " holiday" : "") + ".</p>";
  }
  document.querySelectorAll(".group-picker input").forEach(function(i) {
    i.addEventListener("change", render);
  });
  render();
})();
</script>'))
} else {
  cat("Run scripts/08_bmtx.R and 09_evaluate.R to add the BMT-X results.")
}
```

::: {.card title="How it works"}

Each day a `r bat_desc` plans its charging and selling for tomorrow using the forecast,
and is then paid the actual prices. Backtest over `r bat_days` days. Perfect foresight
plans with the actual prices and is the upper bound.

`r bat_txt`

No fees, no battery wear, hourly instead of 15-minute trading.

:::

::: {.card title="How it works"}

**LEAR** inspired by Lago (2021): one LASSO regression per hour, 24 regressions in total, each
using all 24 prices from days D-1, D-2, D-3 and D-7 plus weekday dummies. Each forecast is
estimated on the previous two years, with lambda chosen by BIC. Prices are transformed with
asinh((p − median) / MAD) to handle spikes and negative prices.

**BMT**, boosting with multiple testing (Kapetanios, Sarafidis & Ventouri), the method from my
master's thesis: same inputs and transformation, but the prices are added one at a time. Each step
adds the most significant price conditional on the ones already in, until none passes a
multiple-testing threshold, then OLS on the selected prices. On average it picks `r bmt_avg_sel`
of the `r bmt_n_cand` lagged prices per hour.

**Tests:** DM = Diebold-Mariano on the daily average absolute error (Harvey-Leybourne-Newbold
correction), GW = Giacomini-White conditional test. Hours = how many of the 24 hours the model is
significantly better / worse (Holm corrected).

**BMT-X / LEAR-X:** the same models with extra candidate variables: neighbour prices from
yesterday, wind and solar day-ahead forecasts for tomorrow, and holidays. BMT-X is run for all 16
combinations of these groups; LEAR-X uses all of them. The model confidence set (Hansen, Lunde &
Nason) keeps the combinations whose daily loss can't be told apart from the best one at 10%
(7-day block bootstrap).

**Bias table:** mean error above 0 means the forecast is too low on average. Mincer-Zarnowitz
regresses the actual price on the forecast; a slope above 1 means the forecast moves too little,
and MZ p tests intercept 0 and slope 1 together (Newey-West errors). Cheapest / peak hour ±1h is the
share of days where the forecast finds that hour within one hour.

**Live track record:** every morning before the noon auction, the forecast for the next day is
saved and never changed afterwards.

**Data:** [Energi Data Service](https://www.energidataservice.dk) (Energinet).<br>
**Code:** [github.com/jacobazu/dk1-price-forecasting](https://github.com/jacobazu/dk1-price-forecasting)<br>
**Last updated:** `r format(with_tz(Sys.time(), "Europe/Copenhagen"), "%d %B %Y, %H:%M")` (Danish time)

:::
